title: Juicy Crispy Dutch Fish Fritters
description: A kid-friendly Dutch dish featuring fish, single cream, and a hint of mustard, wrapped in banana leaves and fried to a crispy golden brown. This pescatarian-friendly snack is perfect for any occasion.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, single cream, whole milk, Dijon mustard, and eggs to make the batter.
Add the cut cod pieces to the batter and mix until they are fully coated.
Heat about 1/2 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the battered cod into the hot oil and fry until golden brown.
Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Wrap each fritter in a banana leaf and serve immediately.
To make the fritters extra crispy, you can fry them twice, once at 325 degrees Fahrenheit and again at 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Serve the fritters hot and enjoy.
If desired, serve with a side of lemon wedges or tartar sauce.
To store leftovers, wrap the fritters in plastic wrap or aluminum foil and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
